annotations.title: Put yourself in a video you have a link to

description: For a person who has a link to one specific video and wants to be in it ("put me in this TikTok", "swap my face into this Reel"). Returns a Jump on the Trend page with that video loaded: they add a photo there, pick who to replace, see a free preview still, then make up to 30 seconds of it with their face in. Works with public TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook, Threads, Reddit, Snapchat and Vimeo video links. Nothing is made from chat; give the person the link.

url.description: The link to the video the person wants to be in.
